summary: LoRA adapter v2a epoch1, greedy decoding
hypothesis: Training the on-device model on a larger set of distilled question pairs (558 train pairs, up from the prior corpus) should push quality above the in-context plateau, because more examples give the adapter stronger signal on specificity and naturalness — dimensions where the base model consistently underperforms Sonnet.
technique: A single greedy (deterministic) on-device call using a LoRA adapter (adapter_v2a_e1) fine-tuned on 558 training pairs at lr 5e-4, early-stopped at epoch 1. Greedy decoding was adopted to eliminate sampling noise that had previously masked adapter gains.

stages.text: Single greedy call, adapter v2a epoch 1
